In both the one-year (FY23–FY24) and two-year (FY22–FY24) comparisons, **United Airlines Holdings ranks first** in revenue growth among the five carriers, both with and without the Hawaiian acquisition adjustment for Alaska. The overall rank order (United > Delta > Southwest > Alaska > American) is identical across both time horizons.
